cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Marketing team.
Data is our fuel at [Company name masked]. With more than 15 million days booked on the platform last year, by 3 million active guests, data is ever-more abundant and valuable. Data Science leverages that raw data to propel [Company name masked] on its mission to put the world's 1.5+ billion cars to better use. Our goals include keeping the marketplace safe, matching the right car for our guests' next adventure, finding the best price for our hosts' vehicles, promoting [Company name masked]'s unique offering by driving impactful marketing strategies, and empowering teams at [Company name masked] with a robust experimentation culture.
We love solving complex problems, value autonomy, and a clear path to success.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
You are a creative and rigorous data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience. You are comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques with the ability to apply them to deliver measurable business impact.
You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support work across domains, actively utilizing it to work-through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You're someone who enjoys working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You have a passion for contributing to a best in class product and take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, ability to efficiently query large datasets.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in cross functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics and Engineers.
Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient/effective path to success.
Experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.

cond_0015.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
Data is central to everything we do at [Company name masked]. With more than 15 million days booked on the platform last year by 3 million active guests, data is ever-more abundant and valuable. Data Science leverages that raw data to propel [Company name masked] on its mission to put the world's 1.5+ billion cars to better use. Our goals include keeping the marketplace safe, matching the right car for guests' next adventure, finding the best price for hosts' vehicles, promoting [Company name masked]'s unique offering through impactful marketing strategies, and building a strong experimentation culture across teams.
We enjoy solving complex problems, value autonomy, and a clear path to success.
You are a creative and rigorous data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience. You are comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques and can apply them to deliver measurable business impact. You regularly think about how data can support work across domains, actively using it to work through challenges and open up new opportunities. You are good at translating unstructured problems into concrete mathematical frameworks, and you can bring others along with you on that process. You enjoy working directly with business stakeholders, staying in regular contact with them to drive experimentation and build a data-centric culture. You can identify the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale. You take ownership of your work from start to finish.
cond_0015.responsibilities:
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has grown steadily, in part through significant marketing investment to bring new hosts and guests into the ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue growing in existing ones, building a strong Marketing organization has become a clear priority, reflected in meaningful growth of the team and its supporting functions.
As the second Data Scientist hire supporting a Global Marketing Organization with a full pipeline of high-impact projects, you will work closely alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist. Together, you will regularly connect to identify focus areas that support your career growth and contribute to company goals — including the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 hosts across the globe. This role focuses on testing and measurement, agile solutions for new markets, Customer LTV Models, audience segmentation, content personalization, and ongoing thought partnership with analytics.
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Actively engage with a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests and development of internal tools. Connect regularly with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support current tactic targeting strategies and ensure guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions from both existing and net-new inputs. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Actively contribute thought partnership to the analytics team on problem approaches, initiating discussions to clarify direction where needed. Support infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service supporting the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0015.requirements:
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Experience working in cross-functional teams, staying in regular contact with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics, and Engineers.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real-world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Ability to think critically, understand and clearly communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient and effective path forward.
Experience working directly and frequently with business stakeholders as a close partner, and comfort initiating those conversations.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment in collaboration with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, with the ability to efficiently query large datasets.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not required, as long as you have worked directly with business teams.

We are looking for a creative and rigorous data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience to join our team. You are comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques with the ability to apply them to deliver measurable business impact at [Company name masked].
You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support [Company name masked]'s work across domains, actively utilizing it to work-through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You're someone who enjoys working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You have a passion for contributing to a best in class product and take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of statistical and ML methods and how they apply to real marketing problems.
cond_0022.responsibilities:
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the [Company name masked] ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to [Company name masked]'s company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host with [Company name masked] across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include The Following
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0022.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, ability to efficiently query large datasets.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in cross functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics and Engineers.
Value Autonomy; Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient/effective path to success.
Experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.

As we expand into new international markets and continue growing in existing ones, building a strong Marketing organization has become a key priority, reflected in meaningful growth of the organization and its supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist working alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist in support of a Global Marketing Organization, you will coordinate on identifying focus areas that support your career growth and contribute to [Company name masked]'s company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 hosts across the globe. This role centers on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing), agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving and expanding Customer LTV Models, exploring new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, and providing thought partnership to analytics.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not required, as long as you have worked directly with business teams.
Testing/Measurement
Coordinate with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and run structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Work with a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests and development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Work with the team to improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Help extend our customer LTV solution to other markets to support scaling operations.
CRM Marketing
Apply ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support current tactic targeting strategies and help ensure guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions using existing and new approaches. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Share thought partnership with the analytics team on problem approaches. Assist with infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0036.requirements:
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Experience working in cross functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics and Engineers.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient/effective path to success.
Experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, ability to efficiently query large datasets.

Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0146.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in Data Science.
Proven track record working in cross-functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics, and Engineers.
Advanced knowledge of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable expertise applying these methods to real-world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Exceptional ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient and effective path to success.
Strong command of a production-ready programming language such as Python, including the ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Deep proficiency in SQL, with the ability to efficiently query large datasets.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience working directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.
Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.

You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support work across domains, actively utilizing it to work-through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You're someone who enjoys working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You have a passion for contributing to a best in class product and take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0199.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, ability to efficiently query large datasets.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in cross functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics and Engineers.
Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient/effective path to success.
Experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.

We are looking for a creative and rigorous data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience. You are comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques with the ability to apply them to deliver measurable business impact.
You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support work across domains, actively utilizing it to work through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You enjoy working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of marketing measurement and the statistical methods behind it.
cond_0265.responsibilities:
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0265.requirements:
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Experience working in cross functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics and Engineers.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Value Autonomy; Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient/effective path to success.
Experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, ability to efficiently query large datasets.
cond_0265.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0272.intro: We are looking for a Data Scientist, Marketing to join our team.
cond_0272.responsibilities:
What You Will Do
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the [Company name masked] ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to [Company name masked]'s company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host with [Company name masked] across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include The Following
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0272.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in Data Science.
Proven track record working in cross-functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics, and Engineers.
Advanced knowledge of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable expertise applying these methods to real-world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Exceptional ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient and effective path to success.
Strong command of a production-ready programming language such as Python, including the ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Deep proficiency in SQL, with the ability to efficiently query large datasets.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience working directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.
Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.

cond_0302.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team in support of a Global Marketing Organization.
Data is our fuel at [Company name masked]. With more than 15 million days booked on the platform last year, by 3 million active guests, data is ever-more abundant and valuable. Data Science leverages that raw data to propel [Company name masked] on its mission to put the world's 1.5+ billion cars to better use. Our goals include keeping the marketplace safe, matching the right car for our guests' next adventure, finding the best price for our hosts' vehicles, promoting [Company name masked]'s unique offering by driving impactful marketing strategies, and empowering teams at [Company name masked] with a robust experimentation culture.
We love solving complex problems, value autonomy, and a clear path to success.
You are a creative and rigorous data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience. You are comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques with the ability to apply them to deliver measurable business impact at [Company name masked].
You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support [Company name masked]'s work across domains, actively utilizing it to work-through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You're someone who enjoys working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You have a passion for contributing to a best in class product and take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
Most people become stronger in this kind of data science work over time as they build experience across domains and learn from feedback.
cond_0302.responsibilities:
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the [Company name masked] ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to [Company name masked]'s company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host with [Company name masked] across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.

You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support work across domains, actively utilizing it to work-through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You're someone who enjoys working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You have a passion for contributing to a best in class product and take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0415.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of Data Science experience.
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable experience applying these methods to real world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Ability to deploy and scale models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Fluent in SQL, ability to efficiently query large datasets.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.

Experience working in cross functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics and Engineers.
Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient/effective path to success.
Experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.
cond_0415.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

cond_0439.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
[Company name masked] uses data to support its marketplace operations. With more than 15 million days booked on the platform last year by 3 million active guests, data is abundant and central to how the business runs. The Data Science team works with that data to keep the marketplace safe, match guests with the right cars, set pricing for hosts, and support marketing efforts. The team values autonomy and a clear path to success.
We are looking for a data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience who is comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques and can apply them to deliver measurable business impact. You should be able to translate unstructured problems into mathematical frameworks and communicate your approach clearly. You take ownership of your work from inception through implementation.
cond_0439.responsibilities:
Testing/Measurement
Coordinate with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments evaluating marketing impact. Apply a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests and development of internal tools. Work with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve the existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of the customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Apply ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support current tactic targeting strategies and ensure guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions using existing and net-new inputs. Support campaign operationalization (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide input to the analytics team on problem approaches. Support infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service supporting the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0439.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of Data Science experience
Deep understanding of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML, with demonstrable experience applying these methods to real-world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering)
Ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient path to a solution
Ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail
Fluent in a production-ready programming language such as Python; able to deploy and scale models into a production environment in coordination with engineers
Fluent in SQL; able to efficiently query large datasets
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in cross-functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics, and Engineers
Experience working directly with business stakeholders as a functional partner
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience
Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not required, as long as you have worked directly with business teams.

cond_0461.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
Data is our fuel at [Company name masked]. With more than 15 million days booked on the platform last year, by 3 million active guests, data is ever-more abundant and valuable. Data Science leverages that raw data to propel [Company name masked] on its mission to put the world's 1.5+ billion cars to better use. Our goals include keeping the marketplace safe, matching the right car for our guests' next adventure, finding the best price for our hosts' vehicles, promoting [Company name masked]'s unique offering by driving impactful marketing strategies, and empowering teams at [Company name masked] with a robust experimentation culture.
We love solving complex problems, value autonomy, and a clear path to success.
cond_0461.responsibilities:
You are a creative and rigorous data scientist with 2+ years of relevant experience. You are comfortable with a range of statistical and ML techniques with the ability to apply them to deliver measurable business impact at [Company name masked].
You're someone who constantly thinks about how data can support [Company name masked]'s work across domains, actively utilizing it to work-through challenges and unlock new opportunities. You're proficient in translating unstructured problems into tangible mathematical frameworks, and are able to bring others with you on that journey. You're someone who enjoys working with business stakeholders to drive experimentation and foster a data-centric culture. You're able to recognize the right tools for each problem and design solutions that scale the impact of your work. You have a passion for contributing to a best in class product and take ownership of your work from inception to implementation and beyond.
[Company name masked]'s marketplace has enjoyed continued growth as a business, which has in part been achieved through significant Marketing investments to ensure we're continuing to bring in new hosts and guests into the [Company name masked] ecosystem. As we expand into new international markets and continue to pursue growth in existing markets, building a best-in-class Marketing organization has continued to rise as a key priority and has manifested in a significant up-scaling of the organization and supporting teams.
As the second Data Scientist hire in support of a Global Marketing Organization with no shortage of high impact projects to work on, you'll work alongside our existing Staff Data Scientist to identify focus areas that can support your own career growth and significantly contribute to [Company name masked]'s company goals and the financial livelihoods of over 150,000 people who host with [Company name masked] across the globe. This role will focus on supporting testing and measurement (market-based testing, synthetic controls, audience testing) agile/lightweight solutions for new markets, improving/expanding Customer LTV Models, pioneering new tactics through audience segmentation and content personalization, providing thought partnership to analytics, and more.
Prior Marketing-specific Data Science experience is preferred but not a requirement for this role so long as you've had experience working directly with business teams.
Testing/Measurement
Work with Marketing partners and external Advertising partners to design, implement, and execute structured experiments to evaluate marketing impact. Utilize a variety of frameworks (e.g. Frequentist Hypothesis Testing, Counterfactual Analysis, CATE) to support in-house evaluation of tests as well as development of internal tools. Partner with Analytics to improve measurement frameworks (e.g. Identity resolution, multi-touch attribution, incrementality assumptions).
LTV Modeling
Improve our existing customer LTV framework to inform global acquisition efforts, audience segmentation, and estimating the long-term impacts of marketing actions (e.g. Re-engagement campaigns). Support extension of our customer LTV solution to other markets to help scale operations.
CRM Marketing
Utilize ML techniques (e.g. Clustering, propensity scoring, multi-target optimization) to support our current tactic targeting strategies and ensure our Guests receive relevant communications. Build and deploy personalization solutions both built from existing and net new. Support campaign operationalization as needed (e.g. Identifying audiences, performing randomized assignments).
Analytics/International Support
Provide thought partnership to analytics team on problem approaches. Support on infrastructure validation and data investigations. Contribute to the growth of a global Data Service in support of the recently established Global Marketing Operations team.
cond_0461.requirements:
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in Data Science.
Proven track record working in cross-functional teams with PMs, Marketing teams, Analytics, and Engineers.
Advanced knowledge of mathematical methods in statistics, optimization, test measurement, and ML. Demonstrable expertise applying these methods to real-world prediction problems (classification, regression, time series forecasting, clustering).
Exceptional ability to think critically, understand and communicate complex problems with a focus on business impact, and identify the most efficient and effective path to success. Strong command of autonomous, self-directed work.
Substantial experience and appetite to work directly with business stakeholders on a frequent basis as a key partner.
A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail.
Deep proficiency in a production-ready programming language such as Python. Strong command of deploying and scaling models into a production environment collaborating with engineers.
Strong command of SQL, with the ability to efficiently query large datasets.
